args.command:
cat > /tmp/analyze_calls.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /bench/repo

# Extract all exported function/method names from internal/ (starting with capital letter)
declare -A functions

# Get all exported functions and methods
while IFS= read -r line; do
    if [[ $line =~ ^func\ \(\*?[^)]+\)\ ([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\( ]]; then
        func="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        functions["$func"]="$line"
    elif [[ $line =~ ^func\ ([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\( ]]; then
        func="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        functions["$func"]="$line"
    fi
done < <(grep -r "^func " internal/ --include="*.go" | grep -v "_test.go")

# Count calls to each function across the entire codebase
for func in "${!functions[@]}"; do
    count=$(grep -r "\b$func\b" /bench/repo --include="*.go" | grep -v "^internal.*\.go:func" | grep -v "_test.go" | wc -l)
    if [ "$count" -gt 5 ]; then
        echo "$count — $func"
    fi
done | sort -rn | head -20
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/analyze_calls.sh
